attchmntText: Five-Star Business Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 19630  Shares pursuant to Employee Stock Options
voiceSummary: Five-Star Business Finance Limited allotted 19630 equity shares on November 13, 2026, pursuant to the exercise of stock options under the Five-Star Associate Stock Option Scheme, 2018. The paid-up share capital increased from INR 29,51,98,578 to INR 29,52,18,208. The exercise price varied across the allotment, with 17000 shares at INR 132.072, 2000 shares at INR 67.44, and 630 shares at INR 1. The company realized INR 23,80,734 from this exercise. The allotted shares rank pari-passu with existing equity shares. The company is completing formalities for listing these shares. Basic earnings per share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was INR 19.33, and diluted earnings per share was INR 19.31.

attchmntText: City Union Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: City Union Bank Limited has co-opted Shri Sankaran G, DIN 120422L27, as an Additional Director designated as Executive Director, effective November 13, 2026. The appointment is for a period of three years, subject to shareholder approval. Shri Sankaran G, aged 52, holds a B.Sc., MBA, and JAIIB. He joined the bank on March 16, 1995, and has over 30 years of experience. His background includes roles in Computer Systems, including Chief Information Officer, ISSM, and CISO. He has contributed to system modernization, digital growth, and cyber security. He currently serves on the Steering Committee at NPCI and holds advisory roles with CAB, Palo Alto, Bharath DB, and IBE. He is not related to any existing directors on the board. The bank confirmed he is not debarred by SEBI or other authorities.

attchmntText: Shriram Properties Limited has informed regarding Announcement under Regulation 31A (LODR)-(8)(a) Receipt of request
voiceSummary: Shriram Properties Limited received a request from Shriram Group Executives Welfare Trust to reclassify its shareholding from Promoter to Public category. The trust currently holds 2,40,500 shares, representing 0.14% of the company. This request follows the divestment of the trust's entire stake in Shriram Properties Holdings Private Limited to Mr. M. Murali. The trust no longer holds indirect shares or voting rights in the company and does not exercise control. The board will consider the request, subject to stock exchange approval under Regulation 31A of the Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Salzer Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Salzer Electronics Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated net revenue for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 579.77 crore, showing 38.40% year-on-year growth. Consolidated EBITDA stood at Rs. 39.95 crore with a margin of 6.89%. Profit after tax was Rs. 14.87 crore. H1 FY27 consolidated revenue reached Rs. 1,077.79 crore, up 25.32% year-on-year. Management cited elevated raw material costs for margin pressure and expects normalization from the third and fourth quarters. The Saudi Arabia manufacturing plant commissioning is delayed to April 2027 due to regional uncertainties. Mr. Raman Krishnamoorthy was appointed CFO effective April 1, 2026.

attchmntText: Salzer Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release".
voiceSummary: Salzer Electronics Limited filed an intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations regarding its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated net revenue for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 579.77 crore, showing 38.40% year-on-year growth. Half-year net revenue stood at Rs. 1,077.79 crore, a 25.32% increase. Q2 EBITDA excluding other income was Rs. 39.95 crore with a margin of 6.89%. Profit after tax for the quarter was Rs. 14.87 crore. The company noted elevated raw material costs impacting margins. attchmntText: Orient Cables (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Orient Cables Reports Highest-Ever Quarterly & Half-Yeary Results in Q2 & H1 FY27;Revenue Doubles to ₹1,018.0 Crore and EBITDA Grows 155% YoY".
voiceSummary: Orient Cables India Limited filed a press release regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 107% year-on-year to Rs. 528.8 crore, while H1 FY27 revenue increased 103% to Rs. 1,018.0 crore. Standalone EBITDA for Q2 rose 158% to Rs. 63.6 crore with margins at 12.0%. Profit after tax for Q2 stood at Rs. 40.1 crore, up 180% year-on-year. Consolidated revenue for Q2 was Rs. 529.3 crore. The company is establishing an 11-acre facility in Bhiwadi, Rajasthan, with completion expected by H1 FY28. A joint venture with Aditya Infotech is set to commence commercial production in Q4 FY27.

attchmntText: Orient Cables (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation

attchmntText: Viceroy Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release for the period ended 30.09.2026.".
voiceSummary: Viceroy Hotels Limited announced unaudited financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total income rose 61% year on year to 93.99 crore rupees. EBITDA increased 81% to 24.68 crore rupees. Profit after tax grew 2.7 times to 3.68 crore rupees. The company completed a rights issue of 105.83 crore rupees. This involved allotting 92,03,008 equity shares at 115 rupees per share. Net worth increased to 375.90 crore rupees. Debt to equity ratio improved to 0.70 times. Marriott Executive Apartments was fully integrated into the company from October 1, 2026. An upgraded banquet space is scheduled to reopen on December 1, 2026. A new banquet hall will open on January 1, 2027.

attchmntText: Viceroy Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Viceroy Hotels Limited filed a presentation with BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026, regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. H1 FY27 EBITDA grew 81% year-on-year to Rs. 24.7 Cr. Q2 total income rose 53% year-on-year to Rs. 48.8 Cr. Cash and equivalents stood at Rs. 110.5 Cr at the end of H1. The company plans to double its convention centre to 20,000 sq ft by December 2026. Phase III upgrades, including Marriott rooms and a rooftop bar, are scheduled for FY28. A 200-key greenfield Courtyard by Marriott project is in the pipeline at Madhapur.
